instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Pull the messages my Telegram bot was sent", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:pull-my-telegram-messages and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads the updates waiting for the bot (messages and edited messages in chats, groups and channels it is in), answers each chat as a conversation and moves the offset past what it read so Telegram does not send it again. A message pulled twice appears once and an edit replaces the older copy. A bot cannot read your own private chats.
4. It reads and writes no rows: the new or changed conversations and items are in the answer, and held.cursor is what to hand back next time.
